name: Elba Aleatico Passito
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata e Garantita, Italy's top tier. Stricter than DOC, and given only to wines that have been DOC for at least seven years.

blurb.text: A wine from Aleatico alone, made on the island of Elba, off Tuscany. It comes from seven communes, including Capoliveri, Marciana and Porto Azzurro.
